name: Automaton
abilities: Immune to poison and disease.
Do not need to eat or breathe.

name: Drakona
abilities: Resistance to fire damage.
A fearsome presence that unsettles lesser creatures.

name: Dwarf
description: Sturdy folk of mountain and stone.
abilities: Darkvision.
Advantage on rolls to resist being moved or knocked down.

name: Elf
description: Long-lived beings attuned to Draft and nature.
abilities: Keen senses — notice hidden details others miss.
Trance instead of sleep; remain semi-aware.

name: Faerie
description: Starna beings of glamour and trickery.
abilities: Minor illusion.
Advantage on rolls to charm or deceive.

name: Faun
description: Hoofed folk of the wild places.
abilities: Sure-footed on any natural terrain.
Can communicate with forest animals.

name: Firbolg
description: Gentle giants, originally from Starna, connected to the natural world.
abilities: Speak with plants and beasts.
Can turn invisible in natural settings once per rest.

name: Fungril
description: Mycelial beings who communicate through spores.
abilities: Spore communication with other Fungril over long distances.
Immune to spores and fungal toxins.

name: Galapa
abilities: Natural armor — +1 to armor score.
Can hold breath for hours underwater.

name: Giant
abilities: Reach — attack enemies one range step farther.
Carry double normal capacity.

name: Goblin
abilities: Nimble escape — disengage as a free action.
Pack tactics with nearby allies.

name: Halfling
description: Small folk with big hearts and quick feet.
abilities: Lucky — reroll one failed roll per session.
Naturally stealthy despite size.

name: Human
abilities: Versatile — gain +1 to any trait of your choice.
Learn one additional language.

name: Infernal
description: Beings touched by burning Draft power.
abilities: Darkvision.
Resistance to fire damage.

name: Katari
abilities: Always land on your feet — no fall damage from heights under 30ft.
Keen hearing and smell.

name: Orc
abilities: Relentless — when reduced to 0 HP, stay up for one more turn.
Intimidating battle cry.

name: Ribbet
description: Amphibious folk of marsh and pond.
abilities: Amphibious — breathe air and water.
Powerful leap — jump three times normal distance.

name: Simiah
abilities: Prehensile tail or feet for climbing.
Advantage on rolls to use tools or solve puzzles.
